title.value: An act to add Sections 108981, 108981.5, and 108982 to the Health and Safety Code, relating to public health.

pfas_definition.provenance: For purposes of this chapter, the following terms have the following definitions: (b) 'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: SEC. 2. Section 108981.5 is added to the Health and Safety Code, to read: 108981.5. Beginning January 1, 2025, no person or entity shall manufacture, sell, deliver, hold, or offer for sale in commerce any cosmetic product that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).
